{{Quote|Quiet, Luugro! That's Calo Nord, the infamous bounty hunter!|translated=1|The Rodian, to Luugro|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''partner'''<ref name="Partner">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Luugro]] was a Rodian with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin who was present on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. They spoke [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and wore a yellow, white, and brown [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] with a gray [[Harness/Legends|harness]] and gold [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Luugro and his partner<ref name="Partner" /> had [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on their heads and were tracked down by [[Calo Nord]], a famous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], in an [[Lower City Apartments|apartment ring]] in Taris's [[Lower City]]. The Rodian recognized Nord and warned Luugro. Nord informed them of his intent to collect the bounties, prompting Luugro to say he would have to collect them over their [[Death/Legends|dead]] bodies. Nord remarked that it was his plan before killing both Rodians with a pair of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistols. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], a former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] whose memories had been [[Amnesia/Legends|replaced]] with those of a loyal [[Republic soldier]], witnessed the confrontation.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Luugro's partner first appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. They appear in a cutscene when the player enters a Lower City apartment complex, during which they die. The player cannot directly interact with the Rodian, and no actions regarding them affect plot, quests, or alignment. Game files from ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' list the Rodian as being of both male and female [[Gender/Legends|gender]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
